verdict.rationale: Choosing region or data residency is a fair axis for a GPU cloud marketplace, but the pack has no first-party documentation of a region, location or residency filter. Search is described as filtering by GPU type, RAM, CPU and bandwidth. Secure Cloud verification covers datacenter tier and ISO certification, not geography. The only location-related item is a community report of a Chinese host posing as a US host, which suggests host location claims cannot be relied on for residency.
